name: SP1 Stage 2 — Strip empty responsibilities after revision

scenarios.name: SP1-STRIP-01 revision with empty responsibilities strips them

steps.text: an LLM that returns a revised ControlStructure with responsibility RESP-1 having PM parts, CAs, and FB channels
the revised ControlStructure also has responsibility RESP-2 with no PM parts, no CAs, and no FB channels
the revision is run
the resulting control structure does not contain RESP-2
the resulting control structure contains RESP-1

scenarios.name: SP1-STRIP-02 revision with no empty responsibilities keeps all

steps.text: an LLM that returns a revised ControlStructure where every responsibility has at least one PM part, one CA, and one FB channel
the revision is run
all responsibilities are preserved in the resulting control structure

scenarios.name: SP1-STRIP-03 responsibility with some parts is not stripped

steps.text: an LLM that returns a revised ControlStructure with responsibility RESP-3 having PM parts but no CAs and no FB channels
the revision is run
the resulting control structure contains RESP-3

scenarios.name: SP1-STRIP-04 warning logged for each stripped responsibility

steps.text: an LLM that returns a revised ControlStructure with two empty responsibilities RESP-2 and RESP-4
the revision is run
the post-revision warnings include a warning for RESP-2
the post-revision warnings include a warning for RESP-4
each warning contains the resp_id and description

scenarios.name: SP1-STRIP-05 stripped control structure passes validation

steps.text: an LLM that returns a revised ControlStructure with empty responsibility RESP-7
the revision is run
the resulting control structure does not contain RESP-7
the resulting control structure has at least one responsibility

scenarios.name: SP1-STRIP-06 responsibility with only responsibility_constraints but no PM CA or FB is stripped

steps.text: an LLM that returns a revised ControlStructure with responsibility RESP-5 having responsibility_constraints but no PM parts, no CAs, and no FB channels
the revision is run
the resulting control structure does not contain RESP-5

background.text: the STPA system model revision module is importable
a control structure and CriticFindings with unjustified gaps are available
